title: Timothy Lam - Videos
description:
Hey everyone, it's Timothy here!

Thanks for visiting my YouTube Channel

I am a Transport Enthusiast (Bus/Tube,Train),  since I was a young boy. I had an interest in MB Sprinter 411CDi / Koch, Plaxton President Dennis Tridnent, Dennis Dart SLF/Plaxton, Dennis Dart SLF/Plaxton Pointer 2. Alexander ALX400 Dennis Tridents, Volvo B7TL Wright Gemini, Volvo B7TL ALX400 &Northern Counties Palatine bodied Volvo Olympian because I had it on my local Route I have also ridden on ECW bodied Leyland Olympians, Dennis Trident East Lancs Lolyne, Scania OmniDekkas. love exploring London and like gaming, 

This channel is a real mix of content, bringing together quite a few of my own interest

I hope you enjoy it, and please do comment requests on my videos! 

Follow me on:
Instagram: @timothylam92
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/talam1992
X:  @timothylam1992
Flickr: https://www.flickr.com/photos/talamtech/


Thanks for watching
